author: entity:mauled_diver_corpse_apprentice_hero
name: Diver Journal, III
pages: This is the third day without food. [Chaser](entity:chaser_scholar_of_the_crimson_contract) refuses to let us near the Ignition [Union](faction:the_ignition_union)'s settlement here. I understand we're at odds with the [Union](faction:the_ignition_union), but... I'm hungry. I'm cold. They have heat there, so I've been told. Their lamps, they can burn away the parasites. A few members of the expedition got fed up with [Chaser](entity:chaser_scholar_of_the_crimson_contract), and tried to sneak away, but they weren't in their bunks the following morning. Maybe they did get away, and are staying with the [Union](faction:the_ignition_union) now? [Skeli](entity:abandoned_diver_journeyman_skeli) told me the [Union](faction:the_ignition_union)'s settlement was along the ground floor beneath the bridges, marked by steam towers, but.. I heard it's dangerous. Bounders reside there. I don't know what to do.. I may just seek out the settlement myself. I need warmth.

The fourth day has come. I'm growing weaker by the hour, as it becomes harder to move. I contemplated eating the snow, but.. I've already seen what happens to those it sticks to. But, I'm hungry.. so, so hungry. Maybe my stomach could handle it? I don't know if the eggs would be able to survive such conditions, or if I'd be sentencing myself to an earlier death. What choice do I have? To die slow hopelessly, or gamble a chance to live? I'll think about it more. If I'm unable to move far, then.. I suppose I'll try it.

There's something inside.
	There's a whisper inside.
	There's movement inside.
	There's something wrong. 
	There's something wrong.
	There's something wrong.
	There's something-
